mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 > 2% YoY growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are expected due to the consistent growth in housing starts (HOUST).
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 6-month moving average and RSAFS is increasing, positive S&P 500 forward returns are expected over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a monetary tightening cycle, a 0.25% increase in FEDFUNDS signals negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of tightening cycle instances with FEDFUNDS +0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the consistent growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS) supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when GDPC1 growth is above 1% QoQ and CPIAUCSL is below 2% YoY, positive S&P 500 forward returns are expected over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of triggered instances.
